title: Binary field representation bits
statement: For each natural number $\ell$, define the field representation bit count to be $\ell$ times one plus the number of binary vectors of length $\ell$, plus six times the number of ordered pairs of such vectors.
caveat: The provided statement does not define the binary-vector enumeration; the exact meaning of the representation bit count is therefore unclear.
